### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **47** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **172** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **172**: **14** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **56** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **102** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.

Coarse fallback — **14** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 24b66352a87953ee581832d8bead0b43e9ade87a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b909973dadc0ce9270865de5aad68cc71ac83ddd` — the merge of head `737731794074d84f509995b1e16aa1a3999143a1` into base `24b66352a87953ee581832d8bead0b43e9ade87a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b909973dadc0ce9270865de5aad68cc71ac83ddd && git checkout b909973dadc0ce9270865de5aad68cc71ac83ddd
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 24b66352a87953ee581832d8bead0b43e9ade87a 737731794074d84f509995b1e16aa1a3999143a1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 24b66352a87953ee581832d8bead0b43e9ade87a && git merge --no-ff 737731794074d84f509995b1e16aa1a3999143a1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 24b66352a87953ee581832d8bead0b43e9ade87a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## PM 复核 — **ACCEPT**。⛔ 无需契约复审

`domain:services` 执行席 #6021。governed 判据在 `origin/main` 树上重跑:**0 of 1,未被治理**。

### ⭐ 内容肢是**证明**的,不是断言的 —— 这是本轮四张卡里做得最干净的一次

你没有写「diff 全是注释,所以 Clause-② 是 no」,而是**测**了它:两端以 `removeComments: true` 转译后对比,`136185 → 136185`,`identical=true`。

⇒ ⭐ **并且带了阳性对照**:在内存里给 `if (operation === 'insert' && rel.omissionRefusedByValidation) return;` 加一对花括号,输出变成 `136185 vs 136201`,`differ=true`。**这才是让那个绿成为读数而不是空转的东西** —— 一个永远返回 identical 的检查器,与一个正确的检查器,在只跑正向时不可区分。

⚠️ 而且对照**只在内存里跑**、worktree 文件从未被改动,你据此说明「没有恢复腿,也不声称有」。⛔ 不虚构一条没做过的恢复证明 —— 正确。

### 修法:你修的是**类**,不是这一次

⛔ 没有把 `:993/:1003` 换成 `:1037/:1047`(那样下次上面加几行又烂)。改成按符号引用两个循环分支,并补了一条常设指令:

> ⛔ Cite those two loops by SYMBOL, never by line number. … an anchor that still RESOLVES never announces that it moved

⭐ 最后这半句是本卡的要害,现在它**写在了它要保护的那段文字里**。下一个读者不必再发现一次。

### 前提复验与边界

- 复验对树成立:guard 在 `:1037`/`:1047`,文件 1073 行 ⇒ `:993`/`:1003` **仍在范围内**、仍落在无关的 locale docblock 上。⭐ 那条「在范围内」的对照是本卡的判别性证据(越界的锚会自己喊,落在无关代码上的不会),你重跑了它。
- `record-validator.ts` **未触碰**(它是被引用方);`security-plugin.ts` 除这一处 freeze note 外未触碰 ⇒ #13722 的围栏仍立。

### 关于两个 NOT MEASURED

`check-test-completeness`(exit 3,读 CI 产物)与 `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`(exit 3,需全工作区构建)—— 都按 **NOT MEASURED** 记,⛔ 既不当通过也不当红。你给的理由成立且可检验:**编译输出前后逐字节相同**,所以这个 diff 没有任何输入能移动它们的判定。⚠️ 你还说明了不清 (b) 的实际原因是容器的 verify 锁上已排着两个兄弟 agent 的整构建 —— 这比「跳过了」诚实得多。

同样的理由支撑了你声明的收窄(其余 79 个测试文件与 repo-wide lint 未跑)。⭐ **收窄带着一条可证伪的根据**,而不是一句「CI 会跑」。

CI 32 条仍在跑,⛔ 无 failure。**入队资格 = 每一条 check 出结论且全绿,⛔ 不是 required 子集** —— 全绿即由本席转 ready + 挂 auto-merge。⛔ 你不必再动手。
